title: Enformer: gene expression predicted from DNA sequence
summary: A Transformer-based model predicts gene expression from 200,000 base pairs of input DNA, over five times more than earlier methods, and is much more accurate at predicting variant effects. Enhancer attribution scores are comparable to methods using experimental data. The post gives no numerical gain and acknowledges that linking enhancers to the genes they regulate remains an open problem.

evidence.tested: Enformer is compared with prior models on variant-effect prediction and enhancer contribution scores against methods using experimental data, with a rs11644125 case study.
evidence.unknown: Linking enhancers to the genes they regulate is described as a major unsolved problem, and many disease variants are spuriously correlated.
evidence.ai_role: Transformer model predicted gene expression from 200,000 base pairs of DNA.
